notes: This lock drives repository vendoring on Windows ARM64.
Normal ARM64 builds and deployments consume runtime/arm64 only and do not install third-party runtimes from the network.
goz is the elevated MFT/USN index service and goz.exe is the unprivileged query client.
Pi is the default TuringDesk Agent Runtime and is vendored with all production npm dependencies.
TuringDesk uses its bundled Node 24 to run Pi; end users do not need Node or npm installed.
DeepSeek Harness remains an independent advanced workbench runtime.
Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is an operating-system prerequisite; only the build SDK/loader is vendored.
